test_PixelFormat_properties: test PixelFormat enum properties like size, channel_count, is_normalized, is_floating_point, and is_srgb
test_CompressedPixelFormat_properties: test CompressedPixelFormat enum properties like block_size, block_data_size, and is_implementation_specific
test_ImageView2D_data_access: test ImageView2D creation with raw bytes and access pixel data via the data and pixels properties
test_MutableImageView2D_pixels_mutation: test MutableImageView2D pixel mutation by creating a view over a bytearray and modifying pixel values in place
